description: Web page reader: fetches one URL and returns its main content as clean markdown with the page title, description, language, and word count. Uses the site's own Markdown version when it offers one; otherwise strips navigation, footers, scripts, and styles. Includes a token estimate. Useful for feeding web pages to an LLM, summarizing articles, or extracting text for research. Not charged if the page can't be fetched or isn't text. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to read.

name: read_page
title: Read a web page as markdown
